name: luminote
description: Coffee's Obsidian-style vault workspace for Lumiverse, published by Prolix OCs
author: Prolix OCs
contributors: Coffee (Lumiverse Discord) — original creator of Luminote

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/backend.ts --outfile=dist/backend.js --target=bun && bun build src/frontend.ts --outfile=dist/frontend.js --target=browser
scripts.release:check: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build && bun run verify:release
